common.helpBody: Use the safe action shown on the page. Verification and recovery links can always be requested again.

auth.homeTitle: A clear start for every project
auth.homeSubtitle: Create a verified account, choose how you work, and enter the right marketplace workspace.
auth.registerSubtitle: Choose your first workspace. You can add another capability later without creating a second account.
auth.clientDescription: Create a client workspace for publishing construction and repair needs.
auth.providerDescription: Create a provider workspace for construction and repair opportunities.
auth.notPermanent: This choice is not permanent. Additional marketplace capabilities can be added later.
auth.constructionSpecialty: Your first provider specialty will be Construction & Repair.
auth.verificationRequired: You must verify your email before entering a commercial workspace.
auth.name: Name
auth.nameDescription: Use your name or your company’s public name.
auth.emailDescription: Use an address you can verify now.
auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to continue to your verified workspace.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we’ll send a secure reset link if an account is available.
auth.resetSentBody: If an account is available for that address, a password reset link is on its way.
auth.resetSubtitle: Set a strong password you do not use elsewhere.
auth.resetSuccessBody: Your new password is ready. You can sign in safely.
auth.verificationSentBody: We sent a verification link to {email}. Commercial workspace access stays locked until the address is verified.
auth.verificationSuccessBody: Your account ownership is confirmed. Continue to complete your marketplace profile.
auth.invalidLinkBody: Request a new secure link and try again.
auth.expiredLinkBody: For your security, request a fresh link.
auth.reusedLinkBody: Sign in to continue, or request another link if you still need one.

onboarding.title: Complete your profile
onboarding.clientSubtitle: Tell providers who they will be working with.
onboarding.providerSubtitle: Create a clear public identity for construction and repair work.
onboarding.activityClientDescription: Briefly describe the projects or property needs you manage.
onboarding.activityProviderDescription: Briefly describe your construction and repair services.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: Keep your public marketplace details accurate.
profile.photoDescription: Photo upload will be connected in a later phase. You can keep or remove the current reference.
profile.phoneVerificationReset: Changing your phone number marks it as unverified until verification is completed again.

tenders.mapPreciseLabel: Map showing the exact work location.
tenders.mapApproximateLabel: Map showing the approximate work area. The exact location stays hidden until entitlement.
tenders.dirtyWarning: Leaving this page may discard changes to this tender. Continue?
tenders.publishHint: Publish this draft once every required detail is complete.

tenders.cancelReasonHint: Enter at least 5 characters. This reason stays with the tender record.

entitlements.lockedBody: Buy access to see the exact location, the client's conditions, and any attached files, and to send a free offer.
entitlements.mockNotice: Payments are simulated in this release. No card is charged and no money moves.

bidding.amountHint: The amount you will complete the work for, in the tender's currency.
bidding.conditionsHint: Describe what your price covers. At least 30 characters.
bidding.revisionResetsQueue: A revision takes a new submission time, so an equal price is ranked behind an earlier one.
bidding.automaticWinner: At the deadline the lowest valid offer wins automatically. Neither the client nor an administrator can choose a different one.
bidding.comparisonEmpty: No offers have been received yet.
bidding.outcomeExpiredTitle: This tender expired with no valid offer
bidding.outcomeWonBody: Your offer won. The agreement is awaiting confirmation from both sides.
bidding.outcomeLostBody: Your offer was not the lowest valid offer at the deadline.
